replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Occasionally, yes—especially when I encounter complex equations or abstract concepts under time pressure. But because I approach math philosophically, I tend to reflect rather than panic, which helps me stay grounded.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've used AI tools to explore mathematical ideas and verify solutions. It was helpful for visualizing concepts and getting alternative explanations, though I always cross-checked results to maintain intellectual rigor.

Take the first derivative f'(x) and set it equal to zero to find critical points. Solve for x, then use the second derivative test or analyze sign changes to determine if each point is a maximum, minimum, or inflection point.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces dimensionality by transforming data into uncorrelated components via eigenvectors of the covariance matrix.
